action: If you received a notice from LifeTouch Health, use any monitoring offered and watch credit reports and insurance statements for activity you do not recognise.
exec: A mid-sized healthcare breach disclosed eight months after detection, involving clinical data and Social Security numbers.
plain: An Arkansas hospice provider says hackers accessed its network in March and may have copied files on about 38,600 people.
summary: The hospice and palliative care provider said a network disruption identified around March 12 was a cybersecurity incident in which an unauthorized party accessed its network and may have copied files. The federal breach report lists 38,629 people. Data includes names with birth dates, diagnoses, treatment information or Social Security numbers.
title: Arkansas hospice operator LifeTouch Health reports breach affecting 38,629 people

validation.note: One trade outlet citing the federal breach report.

review.note: 38,629 people, March 12 disruption and data types match HIPAA Journal (16 Nov) citing HHS OCR.
